'''Daryl Wayne Preston''' (January 15, 1939 – March 9, 2023) was an American [[astronomer]] and [[physicist]].

== Life and career ==
Preston was born in [[Cyril, Oklahoma]], the son of H. M. Preston, a [[shopkeeper]], and Cleva Elizabeth Donnell. He attended [[Austin College]], earning his [[Bachelor of Arts|BA degree]] in 1961. He also attended [[University of Kansas]], earning his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in 1970.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/memorial/daryl-wayne-preston.pdf|title=In Memoriam: Daryl Wayne Preston, January 15, 1939 - March 12, 2023|work=[[California State University, East Bay]]|access-date=May 31, 2026}}</ref>

Preston served as a professor in the department of [[physics]] and [[astronomy]] at [[California State University, East Bay]] from 1970 to 2001.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.berkeleyside.org/2023/06/14/daryl-preston-obituary|title=Remembering Daryl Preston, astronomer, backpacker, winemaker|work=[[Berkeleyside]]|date=June 14, 2023|access-date=May 31, 2026|first=Bruce|last=Reeves}}</ref> During his years as a professor, in 1998, he was named a [[List of fellows of the American Physical Society|fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://berkeleydailyplanet.com/issue/2000-06-15/article/459|title=Berkeleyan wins top honor at Cal State Hayward|work=[[Berkeley Daily Planet|The Berkeley Daily Planet]]|date=June 15, 2000|access-date=May 31, 2026}}</ref> "for substantially advancing and disseminating the art of experimental physics as taught to undergraduates by developing experiments, publishing books, and directing faculty workshops on laboratory physics for undergraduates".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/aps-fellowship?q=preston&af=true|title=APS Fellow Archive|work=[[American Physical Society]]|access-date=May 31, 2026}}</ref>

== Death ==
Preston died in [[Berkeley, California]] on March 9, 2023, at the age of 83.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://neptunesociety.com/obituaries/walnut-creek-ca/daryl-preston-11192382|title=Daryl Wayne Preston|work=Neptune Society|access-date=May 31, 2026}}</ref>
